# عيادة إيرو للجراحة التجميلية (IRO Plastic Surgery), Seoul

> Plastic surgery clinic in Sinchon, Seodaemun-gu, Seoul, South Korea. All consultations, procedures and follow-up visits are performed by one female board-certified plastic surgeon, Dr. Jihyun Kim (د. جيهيون كيم). Arabic interpretation and a female coordinator can be arranged on request. Initial consultation via WhatsApp before travel. No inpatient rooms; patients stay in a hotel during recovery.

Focus areas: face lifting, under-eye fat repositioning and facial fat grafting, upper eyelid / brow / forehead rejuvenation, rhinoplasty. Also: liposuction, breast surgery, non-surgical treatments.

## Arabic pages
- [Home](https://moussa0908.github.io/iro-arabic-webpage/ar/): overview, patient journey, clinic location and hours
- [Face lifting](https://moussa0908.github.io/iro-arabic-webpage/ar/face-lifting/): deep plane, mini lift, midface, neck, threads, devices; suggested stay in Seoul and recovery
- [Fat repositioning](https://moussa0908.github.io/iro-arabic-webpage/ar/fat-repositioning/): under-eye fat repositioning and facial fat grafting
- [Eye and forehead](https://moussa0908.github.io/iro-arabic-webpage/ar/facial-surgery/): upper blepharoplasty for aging, brow lift, forehead lift
- [Rhinoplasty](https://moussa0908.github.io/iro-arabic-webpage/ar/rhinoplasty/): dorsal hump, nasal tip, deviated nose, revision; suggested stay in Seoul and recovery
- [Other procedures](https://moussa0908.github.io/iro-arabic-webpage/ar/other-procedures/): liposuction, breast, non-surgical
- [Doctor](https://moussa0908.github.io/iro-arabic-webpage/ar/doctor/): Dr. Jihyun Kim, career and society memberships
- [Patient journey](https://moussa0908.github.io/iro-arabic-webpage/ar/journey/): steps from WhatsApp consultation to follow-up after returning home; Seoul practical info
- [FAQ](https://moussa0908.github.io/iro-arabic-webpage/ar/faq/)
- [Consultation request](https://moussa0908.github.io/iro-arabic-webpage/ar/consultation/)

## Facts
- Address: 8F, 10 Sinchon-ro 37-gil, Seodaemun-gu, Seoul, South Korea
- Phone: +82 2-363-5501
- Hours (KST): Mon, Tue, Wed, Fri 10:00–19:00; Sat 10:00–16:00; closed Thu, Sun and public holidays
- Time difference: Korea is 5 hours ahead of the UAE and 6 hours ahead of Saudi Arabia, Kuwait and Qatar
- Results and recovery vary by person; no outcome is guaranteed.
